mapper.select: SELECT r.* FROM alert_rules r LEFT JOIN alert_scan_progress p ON p.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND p.rule_id=r.id WHERE r.enabled=1 AND r.rule_code='EXPORT_TASK_SYSTEM_FAILURE' AND r.threshold_count BETWEEN 1 AND 10000 AND r.window_seconds BETWEEN 1 AND 86400 AND r.cooldown_seconds BETWEEN 0 AND 86400 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tenants t JOIN tenant_memberships m ON m.tenant_id=t.id JOIN users u ON u.id=m.user_id JOIN tenant_member_roles mr ON mr.tenant_id=m.tenant_id AND mr.membership_id=m.id JOIN roles ar ON ar.id=mr.role_id WHERE t.id=r.tenant_id AND u.id=r.owner_user_id AND t.enabled=1 AND m.enabled=1 AND u.enabled=1 AND ar.role_code='TENANT_ADMIN') ORDER BY COALESCE(p.updated_at,'1970-01-01'),r.id

SELECT * FROM alert_scan_progress WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND rule_id=#{ruleId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE alert_scan_progress SET rule_version=#{progress.ruleVersion},window_start=#{progress.windowStart}, window_end=#{progress.windowEnd},last_finished_at=#{progress.lastFinishedAt},last_task_id=#{progress.lastTaskId}, completed=#{progress.completed},version=version+1,updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE tenant_id=#{progress.tenantId} AND rule_id=#{progress.ruleId} AND version=#{expectedVersion}
